biography.plain_text: George Peabody Converse was an American banker, socialite and member of a prominent financial family. In 1929 he married silent-film actress and producer Anita Stewart, and the couple settled in Beverly Hills. Converse also became part of Southern California’s sailing establishment, serving as commodore of Newport Harbor’s club in 1940.
biography.html: George Peabody Converse was an American banker, socialite and member of a prominent financial family. In 1929 he married silent-film actress and producer Anita Stewart, and the couple settled in Beverly Hills. Converse also became part of Southern California’s sailing establishment, serving as commodore of Newport Harbor’s club in 1940.

confidence.reason: Contemporary marriage reporting, later Associated Press coverage and the yacht club’s official commodore register support each material claim.

long_biography.plain_text:
Newspapers identified George Peabody Converse as a New York banker when he married Anita Stewart. Later in 1929, reports described him developing a mechanism intended to transmit electrical energy by radio. He believed it could eventually control aircraft, ships, trains and motor cars from a distance, revealing a technical interest outside his financial career.

In Southern California, Converse entered the organised sailing community. Newport Harbor’s official club register records him as commodore in 1940. He and Stewart also occupied a place in Hollywood society: their Beverly Hills home hosted the wedding of James Roosevelt and Romelle Schneider, with Eleanor Roosevelt among the family guests.
